_meta.note: PREVIEW SEED — illustrative figures so the site renders before the first scheduled scrape. The Issue Radar GitHub Action replaces this automatically with live mention counts and real, linked example posts.

recommendation.summary: Lightweight performance auditor that finds the real bottleneck (disk, thermals, background apps, drivers).
recommendation.opportunity: Crowded with junk 'cleaners'; room for an honest, no-bloat tool.

recommendation.summary: Crash-dump / minidump analyser that translates stop codes into plain-English causes and a fix checklist.
recommendation.opportunity: Stop codes are cryptic; users want a translation, not a forum.

recommendation.summary: A guided, step-by-step boot-diagnostic walkthrough that rules out PSU, RAM, GPU and display issues in order.
recommendation.opportunity: High volume, high anxiety, poorly served by scattered forum posts.

recommendation.summary: Connection doctor that pinpoints whether the fault is the device, the router, the ISP or DNS — and what to do next.
recommendation.opportunity: Users can't tell whose fault it is; clarity is the product.

recommendation.summary: Driver & update fixer that resolves failed installs and matches the correct driver versions automatically.
recommendation.opportunity: Existing 'driver updater' tools are notoriously scammy.

recommendation.summary: Second-opinion malware scanner + breach checker with clear remediation steps, without the upsell.
recommendation.opportunity: Trust gap in the AV market — a transparent tool stands out.

recommendation.summary: Automated backup + guided recovery with health alerts before a drive actually dies.
recommendation.opportunity: Pain is severe and emotional; people pay to avoid losing data.

recommendation.summary: An issue-aware help layer that detects the exact app + error and serves a verified fix instead of a search rabbit hole.
recommendation.opportunity: Maps directly onto Velocitry's aggregation engine.

recommendation.summary: Thermal monitor with plain-language alerts and a maintenance schedule (repaste, dust, fan curves).
recommendation.opportunity: Preventative angle — sell peace of mind, not panic.

recommendation.summary: Plug-and-play peripheral troubleshooter that checks drivers, ports and OS audio/video routing.
recommendation.opportunity: Quick wins; great low-friction entry product.
